On Wed, Oct 22, 2025 at 11:00 AM Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. Sharing a minimal "Mutual Path Quickstart" template and a Week 0 checklist; I've created a Google Doc and a quick spreadsheet for owners/tasks.

Thanks — I added a short tech readiness section into the doc and left inline comments on the performance targets. A few quick items from my side that should go into Week 0 (technical):
- API access: create a service account + api key; whitelist Redwood IPs if you want traffic to the dedicated endpoint.
- Sample data: 2–3 representative files (10–50 examples each), anonymized where possible.
- Perf targets: 95th pct latency target, and tokens/sec baseline for steady-state simulation.
- Observability: include a small set of trace/span tags (request_id, model_variant, customer_stanza) so we can link errors to logs.
- Security: confirm if SOC2-restricted data will be in the pilot; if so, we need a signed DPIA.

I'll be on the kickoff to run through the readiness checklist and the staged rollout plan.

-Jonas
Principal Inference Engineer, Redwood Inference
